h_answer: The short answer: what a night costs
p_answer: Straight to it. For roughly 9pm to 1am around Asok, the per-person total falls into three bands depending on how you spend the night. Dinner and accommodation are not included.

note_answer: All figures are per person with drinks, the 10% service charge and 7% VAT included, and dinner and transport excluded. Sharing a bottle across a group brings the per-person number down; a run of lady drinks pushes it up. The breakdown below shows where each THB goes.
p_breakdown: Here is what actually appears on the bill around Asok, by venue type. Bangkok nightlife is not priced by admission — it is priced by what you drink and where you sit — so knowing the unit prices is what makes a bill predictable.

p_models: The same street produces very different nights depending on where you put the money. Here are three easy-to-copy patterns, with the arithmetic behind each. Every figure below includes the 250 THB dinner and the 10% service charge and 7% VAT. Note that the restaurants recommended in our dinner section run 2,000-3,000 THB per person on their own; the figures below assume a street-level local restaurant at under 250 THB.
models: Dinner at a local restaurant around 8pm (under 250 THB), one bar on Soi Cowboy with two drinks (360 THB) plus one lady drink (180 THB), then a snack bar on a free-flow plan (700 THB) and a walk back to the hotel. The 1,240 THB spent inside venues becomes about 1,450 THB with service charge and VAT; with dinner, roughly 1,700 THB. This is the night for people who want to see the place first — and holding the budget means one go-go bar, not three.

Dinner, then one bar on Soi Cowboy (three drinks at 540 THB plus two lady drinks at 360 THB), then a private karaoke room for 90 minutes (2,000-3,000 THB). The 2,900-3,900 THB inside venues becomes about 3,400-4,600 THB with service charge and VAT; with dinner, roughly 3,650-4,800 THB. You get both halves of the experience — the stage, and actually sitting next to someone and talking — which is why this shape delivers the most consistent night. For three or more people it is the default.
3. The night you build (two to four people)

Dinner, one quick go-go bar (540 THB), then a private VIP room: 2,000-2,500 THB per person for the set, a 5,000 THB bottle split two to four ways at 1,250-2,500 THB each, a 500 THB nomination fee and 500 THB in tips. The 4,790-6,540 THB inside venues becomes about 5,600-7,650 THB with service charge and VAT; with dinner, roughly 5,850-7,900 THB. A second bottle takes it to around 9,000 THB. This is the night you plan when you want one story everyone retells.
h_hidden: Four things that inflate your bill
p_hidden: Almost every blown budget traces back to one of these four. Handle them and the bill lands where you expected.
hidden: This is the single biggest driver at go-go bars. Each one costs about what your own drink costs, but buying several for several people stacks up fast. Deciding on a number before you sit down changes the outcome more than anything else on this page.
At most venues these sit outside the listed price. Together that is about 17%: on a 6,000 THB tab, roughly 1,000 THB extra. Budget at 1.2x the menu price and you will not be surprised.

The amount and the conditions vary so widely between venues that this site does not publish a single going rate. If you are considering it, confirm the terms before you order, not after — afterwards there is nothing left to negotiate.

Asok and Sukhumvit close at 2am. The 4am licence applies only inside designated entertainment zones — Silom/Patpong, RCA to New Phetchaburi, and Ratchadaphisek. Pushing past 2am means a taxi fare plus a fresh cover charge at a new venue. If the budget matters, treat 1am as last orders.
h_save: Five ways to keep the cost down
p_save: The goal is to cut the overruns, not the fun. In order of how much they actually save you:
tips: Share a bottle across the group
Nothing else lowers the per-person figure as much. A 4,000 THB bottle split four ways is 1,000 THB each — cheaper than the same volume by the glass, and you keep the table.
Pick a venue with a free-flow plan first
Anchoring the night on a free-flow plan from 700 THB makes the ceiling knowable. Walking around looking for somewhere cheap is the pattern that costs the most time and money.
Set your lady-drink number in advance
No need to refuse them. Just fix the ceiling before you start.
Read the bill before you pay
Check whether service charge and VAT are already in, and that nothing you did not order is on it. Ask at the table and it gets fixed; ask on the street and it does not.
Earlier means your choice of seat and an unhurried conversation. The same money buys a denser night.

faq: How much does a night out in Bangkok cost?

It depends on how you spend it, but around Asok the range is 1,500-9,000 THB per person. One or two venues for a light night runs 1,500-3,000 THB; a standard night combining a go-go bar and a private karaoke room runs 3,500-5,500 THB; a private VIP room with a bottle runs 5,500-9,000 THB. All of those include the 10% service charge and 7% VAT. Dinner, accommodation and transport are separate.
Should I bring cash or a card?
Cash in Thai THB is the norm. Some venues take cards, often with a surcharge, and smaller places may not take them at all. Carrying 1.2 to 1.5 times your intended budget in cash is the safe approach.
Do listed prices include service charge and VAT?
At most venues they do not. A 10% service charge and 7% VAT — about 17% together — are added at checkout. Budget at 1.2 times the listed price.
Is it cheaper per person in a group?

At private-room venues the bottle is the part that divides: four people sharing a 4,000 THB bottle pay 1,000 THB each. Set fees, nomination fees and tips are charged per person, so they do not fall as the group grows. At go-go bars group size makes no difference at all, because everyone buys their own drinks.
What time should I arrive if I am watching the budget?
Around 9pm. You get your choice of seat and an unhurried conversation. Later in the night the venues fill up and turn over faster, so the same spend buys you less.
How late can you stay out around Asok?

Until 2am. In Bangkok, only the designated entertainment zones — Silom/Patpong, RCA to New Phetchaburi Road, and Ratchadaphisek — hold a 4am licence, and Sukhumvit and Asok are not among them (as of September 2026). Plan the night around a 1am last order.
